description: Entities and relationships of Morocco's AI ecosystem, each tied to records in evidence.json. Chain: Institution → Initiative → Project → Evidence → Technology → Sector.

entity_types.institution: A public body, university, research centre, regulator, business association, open-source initiative or international organisation.
entity_types.company: A commercial company or investment vehicle with documented AI activity in Morocco.
entity_types.initiative: A national strategy, roadmap or programme.
entity_types.event: A dated gathering at which documented acts took place.
entity_types.project: A specific institute, agreement, platform or product created under or alongside an initiative.
entity_types.technology: A technology family named by a source as the focus of a project.
entity_types.sector: An economic or public-policy sector a source names as targeted.

lifecycle_stages.announced: Announced, presented, or covered by a signed agreement or memorandum; delivery is not documented in this registry.
lifecycle_stages.in-development: Being built or validated, as stated by its developer or an official source.
lifecycle_stages.pilot: Running as a documented pilot or trial.
lifecycle_stages.operational: Documented as running in production by a record that is not an announcement: an observation of the operator's live service, an operator's report of use, or an independent source. The status record's status_basis says which; public availability is not evidence of use.
lifecycle_stages.released: A model or dataset that is publicly downloadable from its stated repository.
lifecycle_stages.unresolved: The recorded evidence conflicts or is insufficient to establish a stage; the entity's note says why.

project_kinds.ai-application: An AI system, product or platform meant to be used by people or organisations.
project_kinds.compute-infrastructure: Computing or data-centre capacity. Operational infrastructure is not, by itself, an operational AI application.
project_kinds.institute: A research, training or innovation institute being created.
project_kinds.agreement: A partnership or framework agreement without a separately documented deliverable.
project_kinds.digital-platform: A portal or digital service that is not itself an AI system, such as a catalogue of AI tools. It never counts as an AI deployment.

origins.based-in-morocco: Stated to be based in Morocco by a source independent of the company. Registration and headquarters are not thereby verified.
origins.self-described-moroccan: Describes itself as based in, or rooted in, Morocco; not confirmed by an independent source.
origins.foreign-moroccan-subsidiary-reported: Origin outside Morocco or unstated, with a Moroccan subsidiary reported only by secondary sources.
origins.foreign-moroccan-operations-verified: Based outside Morocco, with Moroccan operations documented by a primary source independent of the company.
origins.unresolved: Origin not established by the evidence recorded.

entities.name: Digital Morocco 2030
entities.summary: National digital strategy launched on 25 September 2024. Its official targets include 240,000 direct jobs and a rise from 113th to 50th place worldwide on the United Nations ranking of online public services, which the strategy's brochure defines as the Online Services Index, a component of the e-government development index; the 113th place is the strategy's figure, not verified by the registry. The finance ministry's note on the 2025 finance bill states the same objective as the top 50 on the overall e-government development index; the registry does not reconcile the two.
entities.status: Launched 2024-09-25. Targets run to 2030.

entities.name: Morocco AI 2030
entities.summary: National AI roadmap presented by the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform. It is built on three pillars and relies on the JAZARI Institutes network. Its official 2030 targets are MAD 100 billion in added value to GDP, 50,000 jobs and 200,000 certified AI talents.
entities.status: Under implementation according to the ministry (September 2026). Targets run to 2030.

entities.name: JAZARI Institutes network
entities.summary: Announced network of AI institutes of excellence that the ministry describes as the operational arm of Morocco AI 2030 for research and innovation. It was announced as covering the twelve regions, with JAZARI ROOT as its core.
entities.status: Announced in January 2026. The founding conventions of JAZARI ROOT, JAZARI Industrie X.0, JAZARI Smart City and JAZARI EduTech were approved by joint orders in July 2026 (Bulletin Officiel 7534); the Bulletin Officiel publishes only summaries of the conventions, not their signed texts, which this registry has not obtained; no institute is documented as operating.

entities.name: First National AI Conference (Assises nationales de l'IA)
entities.summary: Two-day national conference held in Rabat on 1–2 July 2025 and organised by the Ministry of Digital Transition. Several agreements were signed there, including on an Al Jazari Institute in Nador, green data centres and a UM6P data-centre partnership.

entities.name: Institut Jazari ROOT
entities.summary: Institute planned as a public-interest group (GIP) and described by the ministry as the technical and strategic core of the JAZARI network, around e-government, smart rural and mountain zones, and major sporting events. CGEM and several ministerial departments signed its constitutive convention on 12 January 2026.
entities.status: Constitutive convention signed 2026-01-12 and approved by joint order of 16 July 2026, published in Bulletin Officiel 7534 (13 August 2026). The ministry states that its general assembly was held on 8 September 2026 (MAI-EV-0048); no director, board, staff, premises or activity is documented. Operation is not documented.

entities.name: JAZARI Industrie X.0
entities.summary: Al-Jazari institute for smart industry. A convention for its creation was signed in Fès on 10 March 2026 by three ministries and the four universities of the Fès-Meknès region. Its stated focus is AI, the Internet of Things, advanced robotics and industrial data analytics.
entities.status: Founding convention signed 2026-03-10 and approved by joint order of 22 July 2026, published in Bulletin Officiel 7534 (13 August 2026). The ministry states that its general assembly was held on 8 September 2026 (MAI-EV-0048); no director, board, staff, premises or activity is documented. Operation is not documented.

entities.name: JAZARI Smart City
entities.summary: Named by the ministry in September 2026 as one of the components of the JAZARI Institutes network.
entities.status: Named by the ministry; its founding convention as a public-interest group was approved by joint order of 22 July 2026, published in Bulletin Officiel 7534 (13 August 2026). The ministry states that its general assembly was held on 8 September 2026 (MAI-EV-0048); no director, board, staff, premises or activity is documented. Operation is not documented.

entities.name: JAZARI EduTech
entities.summary: Named by the ministry in September 2026 as one of the components of the JAZARI Institutes network.
entities.status: Named by the ministry; its founding convention as a public-interest group was approved by joint order of 22 July 2026, published in Bulletin Officiel 7534 (13 August 2026). The ministry states that its general assembly was held on 8 September 2026 (MAI-EV-0048); no director, board, staff, premises or activity is documented. Operation is not documented.

entities.name: Al Jazari Institute, Province of Nador
entities.summary: Institute dedicated to AI research, training and innovation in the Province of Nador. A memorandum of understanding for it was co-signed at the July 2025 National AI Conference.
entities.status: Memorandum of understanding signed 2 July 2025. Operational status not verified.

entities.name: Sovereign green data-centre infrastructure agreement
entities.summary: Agreement signed at the July 2025 National AI Conference with the Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development, on sustainable, high-performing and sovereign digital infrastructure (green data centres).
entities.status: Agreement signed July 2025. In April 2026 a follow-on convention launched strategic studies for a green data-centre programme in Dakhla (Igoudar); no facility is documented as built.

entities.name: UM6P data-centre partnership convention
entities.summary: Convention signed with UM6P at the July 2025 National AI Conference to formalise a strategic partnership on data centres, research, innovation, training and digital sovereignty.
entities.status: Convention signed July 2025.

entities.name: Sovereign AI marketplace
entities.summary: Ministry portal giving access to AI solutions it describes as secure and trusted, unveiled in September 2026 and publicly accessible at ai.mmsp.gov.ma on 18 October 2026. It is a catalogue platform, not itself an AI system; the products it lists are recorded individually only where their use is documented.
entities.status: Operational digital platform, on the basis of public availability observed on 2026-10-18.

entities.name: Idarati AI
entities.summary: Agentic AI assistant for administrative procedures, presented by the Ministry of Digital Transition in September 2026. On 18 October 2026 it was publicly available on the ministry's own services: listed on its AI Marketplace, opened from an "Assistant Idarati" button on the national procedures portal idarati.ma, and answering a test question at chatbot.idarati.ma.
entities.status: Operational on the basis of public availability: the operator's own services showed it live and responding on 2026-10-18. How many people use it, its accuracy and its outcomes are not documented, and operation after that date has not been reconfirmed.

entities.name: INSEA — Institut National de Statistique et d'Économie Appliquée

entities.name: AIOX Labs
entities.summary: AI studio and venture builder that describes itself as having roots in Morocco and a footprint in the EU and US. Its investor UM6P Ventures states that DeepEcho emerged from it. The DarijaBERT model card names an "AIOX Lab" as co-releaser; linking that name to this company is an inference.

entities.name: DeepEcho
entities.summary: Startup that its investor UM6P Ventures describes as Morocco-based and as having emerged from the AIOX Labs studio, developing AI software for prenatal ultrasound diagnosis. UM6P Ventures states it invested in its pre-seed round. Registration and headquarters are not documented here.

entities.name: UM6P Ventures
entities.summary: Deep-tech investor whose own case study states that it invested in DeepEcho's pre-seed round. Its location and its legal relationship to UM6P are not documented in the recorded excerpts.

entities.name: Nexus Core Systems
entities.summary: Company reported to have signed a memorandum with Moroccan authorities at GITEX Africa 2026 for an AI factory platform, and to have installed a managing director for a Moroccan subsidiary. Only secondary press sources are recorded; the subsidiary's registration and operations are not verified.
entities.note: Origin is recorded from the press report's reference to the company's "filiale marocaine" (Moroccan subsidiary). The parent company's country of incorporation is not stated in the recorded source.

entities.name: Toubkal supercomputer
entities.summary: High-performance computing system at the African Supercomputing Centre of Mohammed VI Polytechnic University, installed in 2020 and listed in the June 2026 TOP500 at rank 409, with 71,232 cores and a 3.16 PFlop/s Linpack result. It is general-purpose computing infrastructure with CPU and GPU partitions. Authors affiliated with its host university report AI workloads run on it, including the training of a genomic language model; no independent documentation of its AI use, nor its scale or users, is recorded in this registry.
entities.status: Operational compute infrastructure, as listed in the June 2026 TOP500 (benchmark result unchanged since June 2021). Current utilisation not documented.

entities.name: Nexus AI Factory

The ministry states a first phase at Nouaceur (MAD 5 billion, 16 MW) as a commitment.
entities.status: Announced (memorandum signed April 2026). No construction, commissioning or operation is documented in the recorded sources.

entities.name: DeepEcho AI ultrasound software
entities.summary: Software that uses deep learning to assist ultrasound video diagnosis in prenatal care. On 23 May 2025 the FDA cleared a device named DEEPECHO under 510(k) K242594, for an applicant named DeepEcho with a Delaware address; the registry associates that record with this software by name, device type, web domain and Moroccan data sites, not by a documented legal identity. The Moroccan government says DeepEcho's solution obtained FDA "approbation"; the company's own website still carries an older disclaimer saying its claims are not FDA-validated. A Moroccan public-sector evaluation is planned under a May 2026 convention.
entities.status: Unresolved: an associated US 510(k) clearance is documented (May 2025), but no clinical or commercial use in Morocco is documented, and the developer's own site gives an outdated regulatory status.
entities.note: Unresolved because the sources conflict and use is undocumented: the FDA database lists 510(k) clearance for a DEEPECHO device (May 2025) while the developer's website still says its claims are not FDA-validated, and no clinical or commercial use in Morocco is documented. A 510(k) clearance permits marketing in the United States; it is not deployment, not authorisation in Morocco and not evidence of clinical outcomes. The applicant's legal relationship to the Morocco-based company is not documented. The planned Moroccan public-sector evaluation is recorded separately as an announced project.
